scope: Final independent diagnosis of the Click Delivery /Client/ HTTP 401. Bounded read-only probe matrix against /Client/getorder only; terminated immediately after repeated 401s. No setorder, no removeorder, no shipment, no account change.
bounds: 10 total HTTP requests across the whole diagnosis (P1-P5 + P6-P7 re-run + one real-account request)
only POST/GET /Client/getorder; setorder and removeorder were never contacted
sample credentials for the probe matrix; one single request with the real authorized account (values withheld)
boundary Order_ID = 0 (documented IDs start at 1, so no real shipment can match)
no retries, no credential guessing, no username enumeration

probeMatrix.condition: POST JSON, Authorization: client, Content-Type: application/json, body with Order_ID 0 and published sample credentials
probeMatrix.reading: the Authorization gate passed and the application rejected the credential pair

probeMatrix.condition: same request with NO Authorization header
probeMatrix.reading: the gate rejects before any credential evaluation
body encoding does not change the outcome; the gate + credential check still apply

probeMatrix.responseBody: {"Message":"The requested resource does not support http method 'GET'."}
probeMatrix.reading: method routing isolated from the auth outcome; route is POST-only

probeMatrix.condition: empty JSON body {} with Authorization: client
probeMatrix.reading: gate and credential check run before payload validation

probeMatrix.condition: Authorization value case variant (capital first letter)

probeMatrix.reading: any value other than the exact literal client fails the gate

findings: The 401 is application-generated: no WWW-Authenticate challenge header; the body is a JSON envelope with two distinct messages.
The exact, case-sensitive literal Authorization: client is a mandatory first gate. Absent or altered ⇒ {"error":{"Message":"Unauthorized"}}.

With the gate satisfied the request reaches the credential check; the observed outcome for every tried pair is {"error":{"Message":"بيانات مستخدم غير صحيحة"}} — the same outcome the owner's earlier attempts produced.

Velnix request composition matches the documented contract byte-for-byte in structure: POST /Client/getorder, Authorization: client, Content-Type: application/json, JSON body with exactly Order_ID, User_Name, User_Pass (pinned by an automated test).
No local defect was found in the authentication request composition; nothing was changed in the send path.
The published sample credentials are design-time samples and are rejected by the live service.

No valid API credentials for client 1603 exist in the local safe context (no stored credential in the browser, keychain or filesystem), so a successful authentication could not be demonstrated and was not attempted with any guessed values.

The client portal exposes no API settings, API keys or activation controls: the only account-level login features observed are client users (display name / login name or mobile / password) and a change-password action. API provisioning cannot be granted from the portal as observed.

conclusion.blockedOn: the /Client/ API rejects the supplied account credential pair at the application credential check; the correct API credential or API activation for client 1603 must come from the provider (the portal exposes no API surface)
stillBlocked: any shipment creation or financial integration

evidenceImage.sanitized: no credentials, cookies, session data or customer data; only field names, redaction markers, statuses and provider error envelopes

realAccountTest.credentialSource: the owner-supplied authorized test account for client 1603 (credential values withheld everywhere: never written to the repository, to logs, or to the evidence files)
realAccountTest.boundaryJustification: Order_ID = 0 is below the documented ID range; the provider's own Postman example uses Order_ID 1 (numeric), and no shipment identifier below 1 exists to match
realAccountTest.requestShape: POST /Client/getorder, Authorization: client, Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json, body {Order_ID:0, User_Name/User_Pass: the account credential pair}
realAccountTest.reading: with the real account credentials the authorization gate passed and the application credential check rejected the supplied pair with the same invalid-user message observed for every prior attempt
realAccountTest.conclusionUpdate: authentication failed with the real account credentials as supplied; the rejection is produced by the application credential check, not by the wire format, the gate header, the method or the encoding
nextSteps: ask the provider to confirm or provision the exact /Client/ API credential for client 1603 (it may differ from the portal credential, or require activation)
or have the owner confirm the exact User_Name/User_Pass pair the API expects; no further attempts will be made without that
